name: kvantum-data-prep
description: Automates the pre-load data preparation for the Kvantum Element X portal and the data review that goes with it. One command takes the raw client extracts plus the maintained template and returns the load-ready file plus ONE document -- the input summary in the client's own layout, the exploratory analysis, and the load rules that decide whether it is safe to upload -- as a self-contained HTML page and a matching workbook.
